senses.gloss: m. pl. (contract. of הָאִילֵּין) these, those, these things.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 24:23">Targ. Prov. XXIV, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:3">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>הֵילֵין תאיניא</he> (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20:1">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite> <he>הלין</he>) these figs here.
